books.title: ABSOLUTE CASSANDRA CAIN: THE SHADOW'S HAND #1
books.creators: Che Grayson (writer), Matias Bergara (artist), Bengal (Cover A)
verifiedFacts: One-shot set in the Absolute Universe and spun out of Absolute Catwoman.
DC announced Absolute Catwoman #1 for a second printing because of demand.
Solicited at $4.99 for Cover A and $5.99 for card-stock variants.
FOC is listed as Aug. 17 by current retailer/distributor listings.
marketEvidence: Absolute Catwoman #1 was reported as the top-selling comic for June 2026.

Completed sales for Absolute Catwoman #1 Cassandra-related variants show real collector willingness to pay premiums, although those transactions are for variants of the parent title, not this unreleased one-shot.
Actual print run and retailer orders for this issue are unknown.
books.thesis: Strongest current FOC thesis: proven demand for the Absolute Catwoman launch plus Cassandra Cain collector interest, at a low cover-price entry. Supply could still be high, so the position should remain small.
unknowns: Whether this issue contains a major new first appearance
Durability of aftermarket demand for the standard copy

books.title: SPAWN 77 #1
verifiedFacts: 64-page first issue of a three-issue miniseries built around McFarlane's original 1977 Spawn concept.
Official Image announcement lists a deep incentive ladder including 1:25, 1:50, 1:100, 1:250 and 1:500 variants.
FOC Aug. 17 and release Sept. 9 are independently listed by current retailer sources.
marketEvidence: Some retailers currently show preorder demand/sold-out status for standard copies or variants.
A retailer lists a sold-out 1:500 signed foil preorder at $499.99, but that is an asking/preorder price, not completed-sale evidence.
Spawn has a deep established collector base, but that does not establish scarcity for this issue.
books.thesis: Potentially strong franchise-event upside from McFarlane, the original-1977 concept and an unusually deep incentive structure. Standard-copy supply is the major unresolved risk.
unknowns: Whether the 1977 concept becomes a durable key

books.title: KARMAN BLADE #1
books.creators: Darcy Van Poelgeest and Ian Bertram
verifiedFacts: New series from the team behind Little Bird and Precious Metal.
marketEvidence: Historical completed-sale data for Little Bird #1 and Precious Metal #1 is predominantly near cover price for standard copies.
Creator pedigree is real, but standard-copy aftermarket appreciation is not sufficiently demonstrated.
books.thesis: This is the deliberate methodology check against over-weighting creator reputation. Interesting book, insufficient investment evidence at $3.99.

books.title: VAMPIRE SURVIVORS #1
books.creators: David Hazan, Jimmy Kucaj, João Canola
verifiedFacts: Four-issue comic adaptation of the Vampire Survivors game.
Titan lists the Sept. 9 release and creative team.
Current fan communications identify Aug. 17 as the preorder deadline.
marketEvidence: Game-fan engagement is visible, but comic-specific aftermarket demand has not been demonstrated.
books.thesis: Strong game IP does not by itself establish comic aftermarket demand. The planned collection also weakens a scarcity thesis.

books.title: STAR TREK #1
books.creators: Christopher Cantwell, Dennis Menheere, Jodie Troutman
verifiedFacts: Part of IDW's Star Trek 60th-anniversary publishing program.
marketEvidence: Major IP and anniversary significance are verified, but no sufficiently strong demand-versus-supply evidence was found for an investment position.
books.thesis: Collector interest is plausible, but plausibility is not enough for a risk-adjusted BUY.
